witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_emit_globals_entail_wit_2_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose the full-resource left disjunct. From PreH9, PreH16 and the code=1 guard obtain the initialized-char size/bytes facts using cm_initialized_char_facts__initialized_emission. Instantiate head_2=head and tail=tail_2. Identify retval with cm_rep_global_size head definitionally; the supplied 0..1048560 bounds make signed_last_nbits retval 32 equal retval. Rewrite size to 1 and cm_global_bytes to the singleton tower_u8 byte. The output and undefined segments then match exactly; cancel the five node fields and tail list, and discharge copied pure facts/reflexive equalities. This joins the char-writer postcondition to the recursive-call assertion.

Establish CMCharTy from code=1 by type cases: scalarity excludes structs; pointer depth nonnegativity and base bounds exclude pointer code=1. Reduce the char size; use existing cm_rep_global_size_matches, cm_global_init_bytes_char and cm_global_bytes_initialized, with singleton Zlength=1. All premises are exactly the branch guard, wf and flag in each assigned VC.

helpers.name: cm_initialized_word_facts__initialized_emission

witnesses.name: proof_of_cmc_emit_globals_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose the full-resource left disjunct and case split globals. For [], unfold cm_global_list_rep and extract node_pre=0, contradicting PreH1. For head::tail, unfold the list predicate once and extract its next pointer. Instantiate nextp with that pointer and head/tail with the constructor components. Unfold cm_rep_globals_safe and cm_data_globals_wf once to obtain tail safety/wf, head wf, nonnegative head/tail sizes and total size<=1048560; lia gives head size<=1048560. Rewrite the cons size in PreH5 and reassociate addition. Cancel all five field resources, tail list and the unchanged two buffer segments, supplying copied pure facts.

split_strategies.proof_of_cmc_emit_globals_return_wit_1_s: The pure return equality follows from globals=head::tail (PreH13), size=cm_rep_global_size head (PreH30), and recursive return equality PreH11. Reduce cm_rep_globals_size on cons and reassociate Z addition with lia. Node fields, tail and buffer form an arbitrary antecedent; there is no existential or spatial transformation for this split.

Substitute globals=head::tail and size=cm_rep_global_size head. Reduce cm_rep_globals_size and cm_globals_bytes on cons, reassociate cursor addition, and rewrite list app associativity to match the recursive output prefix. Unfold the target cm_global_list_rep once, supply node_pre<>0 (PreH12) and existential nextp, then cancel the five node fields and recursive tail list; the defined/undefined buffer segments now cancel exactly. No new arithmetic/list helper is required.

split_strategies.proof_of_cmc_emit_globals_return_wit_2_s: Case split globals and unfold cm_global_list_rep once in the antecedent. A nonempty list yields node_pre<>0, contradicting PreH1. For [], cm_rep_globals_size is 0, so cursor equality is immediate by lia. Extracting the representation pure fact preserves the buffer frame; the conclusion is only a pure assertion.

Case split globals. A cons representation at node_pre=0 contradicts its nonzero pure fact. In the nil case, reduce globals size to 0 and globals bytes to []; rewrite Z.add_0_r and app_nil_r. Preserve/reconstruct the nil list representation and cancel the unchanged defined prefix and undefined suffix. There are no existential witnesses or new helpers.
